lines.cap: Your empty bottle can do this.
lines.say: Your empty bottle can do this.

lines.cap: Crack an egg onto a plate. Try not to break the yolk.
lines.say: Crack an egg onto a plate. Try not to break the yolk.

lines.cap: Take a clean, empty plastic bottle, and squeeze it gently.
lines.say: Take a clean, empty plastic bottle, and squeeze it gently.

lines.cap: Hold the opening right against the yolk.
lines.say: Hold the opening right against the yolk.

lines.cap: Now let go. The yolk shoots up into the bottle.
lines.say: Now let go. The yolk shoots up into the bottle.

lines.cap: Squeezing pushes air out. When the bottle springs back, the pressure inside drops, and the air outside pushes the yolk in.
lines.say: Squeezing pushes air out. When the bottle springs back, the pressure inside drops, and the air outside pushes the yolk in.

lines.cap: Move it over a bowl, and squeeze again. Out it pops, in one piece.
lines.say: Move it over a bowl, and squeeze again. Out it pops, in one piece.

lines.cap: Perfect yolk. Perfect whites. Two seconds.
lines.say: Perfect yolk. Perfect whites. Two seconds.
